Chapter 942: Chapter 7: Taiyuan Relic (Please Subscribe)_2

“This must be the control core of the cave dwelling.” Lin Yuan thought to himself as he immediately began to try touching and refining the crystal stone.

Right at this moment.

Boom!

The entire palace suddenly rumbled, the originally tranquil twelve-sided crystal stone started to glow, an invisible aura converged, forming a round and rolly figure.

This figure had short limbs, looking like a meatball, with round goggling eyes. Once the figure appeared, it stretched lazily and looked towards Lin Yuan.

“Is this the master of the cave dwelling?”

Lin Yuan was incredibly cautious at heart, ready to disperse this incarnation at any moment.

“Don’t worry, my true self died a long time ago, what remains here is just a brand. The round and rolly figure spoke, using the universal language of the Chaos Void.

Even without having learned it, one could understand and communicate with it spontaneously.

“I’ve seen the senior.” Lin Yuan immediately said.

A so-called brand is hardly even a spirit or will, it’s merely a piece of information, a trace that’s left behind.

“Ah, if only I had known not to go to those Taiyuan Ruins, sure enough, my true self didn’t make it out alive.” The round and rolly figure sighed and muttered to itself.

“Taiyuan Ruins?” Lin Yuan listened from not far away, and a surge of turmoil arose in his heart.

Even having never left the Main Universe, he had heard of the name of the Taiyuan Ruins, a notorious dangerous place in the Chaos Void, and of course, also one of the greatest opportunities.

The extraterrestrial aurora that had previously fallen into the Main Universe, as well as that ‘White Paper’, originated from the Taiyuan Ruins.

Many opportunities and legacies within the Main Universe have mentioned the name of the Taiyuan Ruins.

“But I still couldn’t help myself, after all, there exists traces near to a Perfect Time Being, I was trapped at the peak of the Sovereign Realm for dozens of Cosmic Eras; if I obtained some opportunities inside, I would have had a complete hope to step into the Chaos Realm…”

The round and rolly figure talked to itself, its words tinged with regret.

“The peak of the Sovereign Realm?” Lin Yuan inwardly gasped upon hearing this.

The twelfth rank is divided into three levels: Path Splitting, Sovereign, and Chaos.

The peak of the Sovereign Realm, even in the Chaos Void, is considered a powerful being. In the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, during the heyday of the Magic Jade Tower, there were only so many powerful beings at the peak of the Sovereign Realm.

But that such a powerful being had died, died in the Taiyuan Secret Realm?

Lin Yuan couldn’t believe that a being of this level didn’t have any life-saving means; even if their true form perished, it would be very difficult to die completely, but according to the round and rolly figure’s implication, it apparently had indeed died completely.

“Successor, which Chaos Era is it now?” The round and rolly figure looked at Lin Yuan and said.

“Which Chaos Era?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned and hesitated for a moment before replying: “Senior, I am not sure.”

Having stepped out of the Main Universe not long ago, he naturally didn’t know what time period the Chaos Void was in.

“You don’t know?” The round and rolly figure’s brow furrowed slightly; almost any life from the Chaos Void would basically know about the Chaos Era; Lin Yuan didn’t know?

“I am not a being born in the Chaos Void, rather I come from a universe…” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and spoke the truth.

“From a universe?” The round and rolly figure’s expression was puzzled, “Did your universe undergo a great destruction?”

“Not yet.” Lin Yuan said.

“It hasn’t been greatly destroyed, how did you leave…” The round and rolly figure looked carefully at Lin Yuan, its expression becoming more and more surprised, “Have you reached the Seventh Realm in the comprehension of space-time?”

“Tsk tsk, no wonder you can send out an avatar to explore the Chaos Void, only with such advanced comprehension of space-time could you…no, this avatar of yours, is it condensed from Chaos Qi? Have you grasped the Chaos Rule?”

The round and rolly figure was dumbfounded.

As a powerful being at the pinnacle of the Sovereign Realm, it certainly knew how beings inside universes operated; even at the twelfth rank, one likely wouldn’t live beyond a Cosmic Era.

Because when a Cosmic Era ends, twelfth-rank mighty beings must experience the great destruction along with the universe. A typical Path Splitting twelfth-rank would have to die in large numbers just to get through it, to formally enter the Chaos Void.

And Lin Yuan… has yet to experience the great calamity of destruction, yet his understanding of space-time has reached the Seventh Realm? And he’s even comprehended the Chaos Rule?

The former is easy to explain, but the latter? To comprehend the Chaos Rule is one of the most difficult thresholds when a ruler steps into the Chaos Realm; it was precisely for the chance to comprehend the Chaos Rule that he ventured into the Taiyuan Ruins.

“I was rather lucky and happened to comprehend it…” Lin Yuan hesitated for a moment before speaking up.

The plump figure saw that Lin Yuan’s understanding of space-time had reached the Seventh Realm, which did not surprise him. After all, the Space-Time Rule he deployed to stop the island just now belonged to the Space-Time Rule of the Seventh Realm.

It was evident when the plump figure at least resumed control over the island.

According to the information left by the Profound Xuanhuang lineage and the Magic Jade Tower, comprehending the Seventh Realm of space-time is exceptionally rare for the beings within the universe, but somewhat easier within the Chaos Void.

Normally, a peak expert of the Path Splitting Realm would have the hope of reaching the understanding of the Seventh Realm of space-time; for a ruler, their understanding of space-time starts at the Seventh Realm.

But the Chaos Rule? That is quite rare indeed; many peak rulers have not grasped it.

“Within one Cosmic Era, merely at the Path Splitting Realm, to have comprehended the Chaos Rule.”

“Incredible, truly incredible.” The plump figure fell silent for a moment, his face revealing an expression of astonishment.

In fact, if he knew that Lin Yuan was merely at the Eleventh Layer and not at the Twelfth Layer of the Path Splitting Realm, he would probably be even more astoundingly shocked.

If it’s said that reaching the understanding of the Chaos Rule at the Path Splitting Realm has some rumors in the vast Chaos Void, it’s always been the protégés cultivated by the peak beings of the Chaos Realm with endless efforts.

Then comprehending the Chaos Rule at the Eleventh Layer would completely surpass the understanding of the plump figure. Even existences like His Majesty Xuanhuang, the Moyu Tower Master, had only heard of it.

“I never thought that I, Cang Weiyang, having been dead for who knows how many eons, would still witness such a genius,” the plump figure remarked with emotion in his voice.

The lives he knew that had comprehended the Chaos Rule at the Path Splitting Realm were all cultivated with great effort by those Chaos Great Saints, but Lin Yuan? The legacies accessible to the beings of the universe are extremely limited.

Under such circumstances, to still have comprehended the Chaos Rule, the plump figure didn’t know how to describe it.

Lin Yuan listened in silence below without saying a word.

Although he was only an Eleventh Layer being, with a spirit and will reaching forty million points, coupled with the enveloping Chaos Aura, it was very difficult for others to see through his actual realm.

“Within an era, at the level of the Path Splitting Realm, to comprehend the Chaos Rule, you should have a great chance of stepping into the Chaos Realm in the future,” the plump figure Cang Weiyang said.

In fact, even those disciples cultivated by the Chaos Great Saints wouldn’t dare to claim they could surely enter the Chaos Realm; comprehending the Chaos Rule is only one of the thresholds to step into the Chaos Realm.

But Lin Yuan is different from those disciples.

In Cang Weiyang’s view, Lin Yuan’s potential was unfathomably higher than theirs, which was why he said there was a great hope for entering the Chaos Realm.

The phrase “a great hope” was already the highest compliment from the plump figure.

“The Chaos Realm is too far away for me,” Lin Yuan said beside.

He’s currently only at the Eleventh Layer, he’d first need to step into the Path Splitting Realm.

“Too far?” The plump figure Cang Weiyang glanced at Lin Yuan.

“Alright, let’s talk about serious matters.” The plump figure Cang Weiyang composed himself, “This cave dwelling is one of the three I often use for closed-door cultivation, holding eighteen trees at the ruler level and three ruler realm secret treasures, as well as one Chaos Realm secret treasure.”

“Besides, it contains many of the secret techniques I practiced.”

“Three ruler realm secret treasures? One Chaos Realm secret treasure?” Lin Yuan inwardly exclaimed.

Treasures at the Twelfth Layer also come in various levels, ranging from low to high: Path Splitting weapons and treasures, ruler weapons and treasures, Chaos weapons and treasures.

The strongest weapons in the Main Universe, Twelfth Layer weapons, are all Path Splitting level weapons, and the Clan Suppression Weapons of the peak clans are merely the peak Path Splitting treasures or special Path Splitting treasures.

“Logically speaking, since this cave dwelling holds many of my legacies and treasures, I would certainly choose an heir for myself, undergoing many trials, making numerous vows before I hand over everything to him…”

The plump figure Cang Weiyang paused for a moment before speaking in a complex tone: “But I feel I’m not qualified to take you as my protégé.”

“So, everything in the cave dwelling, I’ll give it all to you.”
